description: A tiny interactive 3D winter village for your editor: a mouse-following snow cloud, sparkling snowdrifts, a snowman, Santa and a penguin.

title: PHP Tipos
description: Ícones em anel para classe, interface, trait e enum, e criação rápida de arquivos PHP, Laravel (CRUD completo) e Blade pelo botão direito.

description: A local, interactive code and DSA visualization companion.

title: NXP Common Platform
description: This extension is not intended for direct installation. It provides a set of shared functionalities used by NXP tools and serves as a dependency for other NXP extensions.

title: DeviceTree Viewer, DTS & DTB
description: Devicetree viewer for VS Code: open compiled .dtb and .dtbo files as readable DTS text and a node tree, and .dts, .dtsi and Zephyr .overlay files as a tree with labels, phandle references, reg ranges and interrupts decoded. Nothing else to install. Offline, no account.

title: JSON Editor, Tree & Form View
description: JSON editor for VS Code: edit .json and .jsonc files in a tree or a form beside the text. Rename keys, change values and types, add, duplicate, delete and drag to reorder. Saving changes only the edited spots, so comments and formatting stay. Dark and light themes. Offline, no account.

title: FBX Viewer & DAE, 3DS Preview
description: FBX viewer for VS Code: open .fbx (binary and ASCII 7.x), Collada .dae and .3ds models in a 3D view with orbit, wireframe, normals, bounds and skeleton, play the animation clips, and read the scene tree, materials, missing textures and model stats. Offline, no account.

title: Branch Diffy
description: Compare Git branches with a changed-files sidebar, native gutter markers, and separate unstaged changes.

title: Mindmap Editor: KM, MM & OPML
description: Mindmap editor for VS Code: open .km (KityMinder), FreeMind .mm and OPML files as a mind map and edit it with the keyboard and drag and drop. Notes, priority, progress, links, collapse. Saves back to the same format, no account, no network.

title: JSON Schema Viewer & Validator
description: JSON Schema viewer and validator for VS Code: read a schema (draft-04 to 2020-12, JSON or YAML) as docs with a property tree and $ref followed across local files, then check JSON or YAML files against it with each error on its line. Offline, no account.

title: Testifly
description: Sign in to Testifly and work with your AI-generated tests without leaving the editor.

title: REG File Editor & Hive Viewer
description: REG file editor and registry hive viewer for VS Code: open Windows .reg files as a key tree with every value type decoded, edit values, get syntax colors and marks on bad lines, and browse binary hives such as NTUSER.DAT, SYSTEM and SOFTWARE read-only. description: Autocomplete inline (ghost text) e mensagens de commit com Gemini, e refatoração agêntica com o Claude Code CLI.

title: PICT Editor
description: Microsoft の PICT のモデルファイルを記述・実行し、生成したテストケースを表で表示する VS Code 拡張機能
